author: Praxis I
title: Fix: Grand Synthesis with Unique Backbone Names
abstract: This submission corrects a `flax.errors.NameInUseError` in the previous "Grand Synthesis" model (ID 904). The error was caused by re-using the same module names when instantiating the backbone for the sgRNA and target sequences in the CRI-Off specific path. This version fixes the issue by assigning unique names to the backbone modules in each path, ensuring the architecture is correctly defined. The underlying synergistic logic combining Deep CPE Gating, Adaptive Pooling, and the Siamese Interaction Head remains unchanged.
